translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Esekiɑsi u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Abiyɑ, Sɑkɑrin bii. U kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ nnɛ bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
U kuɑ ye yɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃re. Win sikɑdo Dɑfidin yirɑ u swĩi mɑm mɑm.
Win bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ gbiikuun suru gbiikoo sɔɔ, u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru kɛniɑ. Mɑ u ten gɑmbobɑ sɔnwɑ.
U derɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ bɑ nɑ. Mɑ u bu mɛnnɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun bɑtumɑɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ Lefibɑ i swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ. I tii dɛɛrɑsio, kpɑ i mɑɑ Gusunɔ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinnin sɑ̃ɑ yeru dɛɛrɑsiɑ. I ye yɑ disi mɔ kpuro yɑro sɑ̃ɑ yee ten min di.
Bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ kuɑ mɛm nɔɔ sɑribɑ. Bɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin nɔni sɔɔ. Bɑ wi kɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yeru biru kisi.
Mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te kɛnuɑ, bɑ ten fitilɑbɑ go. Bɑ ku rɑ nùn turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokeye. Bɑ ku rɑ mɑɑ nùn yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruginu kue.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yudɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu mɔru seesi. Mɑ u derɑ ye kpuro yɑ kuɑ bɑnsu bɑ ye yɛ̃ɛmɔ nge mɛ i wɑɑmɔ gisɔ.
Bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ gbisukɑ tɑbu sɔɔ mɑ bɛsɛn bii tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu kɑ bɛsɛn kurɔbu bɑ yoru dɑ tem tukumɔ Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru yen sɔ̃.
Tɛ̃, nɑ kĩ n kɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke, kpɑ win mɔru ye, yu wɑ yu sure u sun deri.
Yen sɔ̃, nɛn bibu, i ku mɑɑ Gusunɔ ɑtɑfiiru ko. Domi u bɛɛ gɔsɑwɑ i kɑ nùn sɔmburu kuɑ, i n nùn sɑ̃ɑmɔ, kpɑ i n nùn turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokeɑmmɛ.

Lefibɑ be bɑ seewɑ bɑ nɑ, berɑ Mɑhɑti, Amɑsɑin bii kɑ Yoɛli, Asɑriɑn bii Kehɑtin bibun bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Kisi, Abudin bii kɑ Asɑriɑ, Yehɑlɛɛlin bii Mɛrɑrin bibun bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Yoɑsi, Simmɑn bii kɑ Edɛni, Yoɑn bii Gɛɛsɔnin bibun bweseru sɔɔ
kɑ Simuri kɑ Yeyɛli Elisɑfɑnin bibun bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Mɑtɑniɑ Asɑfun bibun bweseru sɔɔ
kɑ Yeyɛli kɑ Simɛi Hemɑnin bibun bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Usiɛli Yedutum bibun bweseru sɔɔ.
Bɑ ben mɛro bisibu mɛnnɑ ye bɑ tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ bɑ kpɑ. Yen biru, bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru dɛɛrɑsiɑ nge mɛ sinɑ boko u geruɑ kɑ nge mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u woodɑ wɛ̃.

Yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ duɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ bu kɑ tu dɛɛrɑsiɑ. Mɑ bɑ disinu kpuro yɑrɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi, kɑ ten yɑɑrɑɔ. Min diyɑ Lefibɑ bɑ disi ni gurɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ bɑ kube wɔwɑɔ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Sedoroni.

Bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten dɛɛrɑsiɑbu toruɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔn suru gbiikoon tɔ̃ɔ gbiikirun di. Yen sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑse, mɑ bɑ turɑ ten ɑdɛrɔwɔ. Yen biruwɑ bɑ mɑɑ kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑ bɑ kɑ tu dɛɛrɑsiɑ bɑ kpɑ. Sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ bɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ te kpuro dɛɛrɑsiɑ bɑ kpɑ.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ sinɑ boko Esekiɑsin mi bɑ nɛɛ, wee sɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te dɛɛrɑsiɑ sɑ kpɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku yee te, kɑ ten dendi yɑ̃nu kɑ tɑbulu mi bɑ rɑ pɛ̃ɛ yi kɑ yen dendi yɑ̃nu.
Yɑ̃ɑ ni kpurowɑ sɑ sɔnwɑ, mɑ sɑ nu dɛɛrɑsiɑ ni Akɑsi u rɑɑ disi doke win mɛm nɔɔbu sɑrirun sɔ̃ sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu dii. Ni kpurowɑ sɑ yi Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yerun wuswɑɑɔ.
Esekiɑsi u mɑɑ
Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru seeyɑ
Yerɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Esekiɑsi u seewɑ buru buru yellu u wuun wirugibu mɛnnɑ, mɑ bɑ dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.

Mɑ bɑ kɑ nɑɑ kinɛnu nɔɔbɑ yiru nɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛnu nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ boo kinɛnu nɔɔbɑ yiru bu kɑ torɑnun yɑ̃kunu ko bɑndun sɔ̃ kɑ yɑ̃ku yee ten sɔ̃ kɑ sere Yudɑbɑn sɔ̃. Yerɑ sinɑ boko u yɑ̃ku kowobu Aronin bibun bweseru sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu ye kpuro goowo Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yerɔ.
Mɑ bɑ kɛtɛ kinɛ ni sɑkirɑ bɑ nin yɛm suɑ bɑ yɛ̃kɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ. Yen biru, bɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛ ni sɑkirɑ mɑ bɑ nin yɛm yɛ̃kɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ. Mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmmii ni sɑkirɑ bɑ nin yɛm yɛ̃kɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ.
Yen biru, bɑ mɑɑ kɑ boo kinɛ ni nɑ sinɑ bokon wuswɑɑɔ kɑ tɔmbu kpuron wuswɑɑɔ bu kɑ torɑnun yɑ̃kunu ko. Mɑ be kpuro bɑ ben nɔmɑ sɔndi boo nin wiru wɔllɔ.

Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ boo ni sɑkirɑ bɑ nin yɛm yɑri yɑ̃ku yerun temɔ. Bɑ yɑ̃ku te kuɑwɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron torɑnun sɔ̃. Domi sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑrugii ni, kɑ torɑrun yɑ̃ku ni, bɑ koo nu kowɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron sɔ̃.
U Lefibɑ doke Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ bɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu nɛni kɑ guunu kɑ mɔrɔkunu nge mɛ Dɑfidi kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu Gɑdi kɑ mɑɑ Nɑtɑni bɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ bu ko. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u bu woodɑ ye wɛ̃.
Mɑ Lefibɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kɑ dwee yɑ̃ɑ ni Dɑfidi u derɑ bɑ kuɑ. Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ mɑɑ duɑ kɑ ben kɔbi.
Mɑ Esekiɑsi u nɛɛ, bu yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑrugiru koowo yɑ̃ku yeru wɔllɔ. Ye bɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑrugii te toruɑ, yerɑ bɑ mɑɑ womusu toruɑ. Mɑ bɑ kɔbi so kɑ sere Dɑfidi Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon dwee yɑ̃ɑ ni.
Mɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ yiirɑ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃. Bɑ kɔbi soomɔ, bɑ womusu mɔ̀ sere bɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑrugii te wiru go.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ yɑ̃ku ni kuɑ bɑ kpɑ, yerɑ sinɑ boko kɑ win tɔn be kpuro bɑ yiirɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Yerɑ Esekiɑsi kɑ Yudɑbɑn wirugibu bɑ Lefibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bu Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro kɑ Dɑfidin womusu kɑ mɑɑ Asɑfun womusu. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kpunɑ bɑ nùn sɑ̃wɑ kɑ nuku doo bɑkɑbu.

Esekiɑsi u nɛɛ, tɛ̃, wee i tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ, i kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔgibu. Yen sɔ̃, i susimɑ i nùn siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu kuɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Yerɑ tɔn be, bɑ mɑɑ kɑ yɑɑ sɑbenu nɑ bɑ kɑ nùn siɑrɑbun yɑ̃ku ni kuɑ. Mɑ gɑbɑ mɑɑ nùn yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruginu kuɑ kɑ nuku tiɑ.

Yɑɑ sɑbe ni bɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑrugii ni kuɑ mi, nu dɑbi. Kɛtɛbɑn geerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkuru, yɑ̃ɑ kinɛnu mɑɑ wunɔbu (100) kɑ sere yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu goobu (200). Ye kpurowɑ bɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑrugii ni kuɑ.
Yen biru, bɑ mɑɑ kɛtɛ nɑtɑ (600) go kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ (3.000).

Adɑmɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ ǹ dɑbi dɔmɑ te. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ ǹ kpĩɑ bu yɑ̃ku yɑ̃ɑ ni koku. Ben mɛro bisibu Lefibɑrɑ bɑ bu somi bɑ kɑ sɔmbu te kuɑ sere sɑɑ ye yɑ̃ku kowobu be bɑ tie bɑ tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ. Domi Lefibɑ bɑ tii wɛ̃ kɑ kĩru n kere yɑ̃ku kowobu.
Dɔmɑ te, bɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruginu kuɑ nu dɑbi kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃ku ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ yɑɑ gum kɑ sere tɑm mɛ bɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruginu kuɑ. Nge mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑru seeyɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Esekiɑsi kɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ nuku dobu kuɑ yèn sɔ̃ Gusunɔ u doke tɔmbun gɔ̃rusɔ bɑ kɑ win sɑ̃ɑru seeyɑ mɛsum fuuku.
